program.description: Path to the executable program to query for supported features

feature_opt.description: Command-line option passed to the program to obtain its feature list

feature_prefix.description: Prefix string to match in program output to locate the feature list

output_format.description: Output format for the feature list when using feature-check -l (valid: 'json' or 'tsv')

default_check.description: Default feature check expression (e.g., 'AsynchDNS ge 0.1') used when no explicit feature is provided
